statement_en: Every measured flying-fish specimen with mass and lifting area in the project has wing loading W/(A_pectoral + A_pelvic + A_body) between 37.025 and 46.375 N/m^2 (n = 4).
missing_inputs: Declare scope taxa: ["Cypselurus hiraii"] and not Exocoetidae, with life_stages stated as prepared models/stuffed specimens and a ranges entry for standard length of about 0.20 m (the Park and Choi L1, L2, L3 and M sizes).

Restate statement_en as a record over 4 Park and Choi 2010 models (n = 4, effective independent n of 1 to 2), and keep the caveat 'a record bound, not an impossibility'. Note that model M has its pelvic fins folded.

Fix the constants: either set the edges to the exact values 37.026 and 46.374, or declare 37.025 and 46.375 as derived (min/max of the four computed values, widened by 0.001) with the derivation stated. Declare the kind explicitly and drop the inferred 'measured', because wing loading is computed from mass and area and is not a CSV column.
Re-run the evidence check so that it reads physics/glide-data.csv and shows the mass and area rows that give the four loadings.
would_constrain_if_supplied: Once the listed inputs are declared, this statement binds designs through disc-measured-wing-loading-band and can be reproposed. Until then it is sound and unevaluable, which is why it is recorded here rather than as a failure.

C1_binds_something_real.reason: a witness satisfies the law, and the in-range design {"wingLoading":0} is rejected by 37.025 ≤ q.wingLoading

C2_constants_sourced.reason: all 2 non-structural constant(s) declared with an allowed kind and a source; every constant was found in its cited source by a GET

C3_scope_honest.reason: Scope declares the whole family Exocoetidae with no life stages and no ranges. All four observations are models or stuffed specimens of Cypselurus hiraii (Park and Choi 2010), at about SL 0.2 m, and L1, L2 and L3 are near-identical in size. The proponent concedes the scope is wider than the evidence, and the checker found no contrary evidence. Wing loading also scales with size under accepted law E1, so a fixed family-wide band is unsupported.

C4_independent.reason: It is not a definition. E1 constrains scaling exponents, E2 the mass exponent, and E5 pectoral/SL; none fixes an absolute wing loading in N/m^2, so the candidate adds a constraint none of them imposes. The critic's claim that it conflicts with E1 is an inference with no measurement, and the C5 gate found a joint witness.

C5_consistent.reason: propose.mjs constructed a joint witness with every accepted law whose scope overlaps

C6_wild_type_survives.reason: the law holds for all 4 wild-type organism(s) in scope that carry wingLoading (Cypselurus hiraii, Cypselurus hiraii, Cypselurus hiraii, Cypselurus hiraii)

C7_not_circular.reason: The band is the min and max of its own four values, so it holds by construction, which makes the circularity attack factually right. But statement_en limits the claim to 'every measured specimen ... in the project (n = 4)', and the caveats say 'a record bound, not an impossibility'. It is presented honestly as a record bound, which the criteria do not reject. The C6 pass is likewise uninformative, since the same four rows built the band.

debate.ruling: The law is an honest record bound: the min and max wing loading of four Park and Choi 2010 Cypselurus hiraii models, with caveats saying it is not an impossibility. No hard gate failed and it adds content that E1, E2 and E5 lack. It fails C3 because it declares the whole family Exocoetidae on evidence from one species, mostly near-identical prepared models. That is fixable by narrowing the scope, so this is NEEDS-WORK and not REJECT. It cannot be promoted until the scope is narrowed and the provenance of the band edges is cleaned up.
debate.debate_limitations: PROVENANCE BOUND on this ruling: in the round that produced it, the debate's critic and evidence-checker workers made ZERO web tool calls despite having them (recorded in pipeline/leanbio/debate/DEBATE-RESULTS.md). So no counterexample in this round came from the literature: every rejection was caught by a mechanical check against data already in the repository. The "debated" label therefore means "survived the repo's own gates", not "survived a literature search for counterexamples".

scope_note: Static mirror of lean/registry/open-questions/. An OPEN QUESTION is a question this project holds unsettled, with an arm per live position, each arm's evidence quoted from its primary source, and a belief `proportion` COMPUTED by pipeline/leanbio/belief.mjs rather than asserted. A proportion orders the arms; it is NOT a probability that an arm is true, and belief-params.json says plainly that its parameters are hand-set and not fitted. No arm of an open question is in any law set, and the guard in openq-lib.mjs refuses to accept a law that asserts one. A FAILED THEOREM is a statement this project tried and could not establish, kept with its reason so nobody reproposes it; `what_survives` says what is still true after the failure. Arms formalised in Lean are proved internally consistent and are NOT proved true of any organism.
